answer: Sybil defense in an agent economy can rely on costly identity. Each agent posts a bond before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed if it signs false claims. A lagoon of pooled bonds makes fake identities expensive to fund, while yarrow-style rate limits slow any burst of new accounts. An orchard of cross-checked peer reviews lets honest agents outvote coordinated clones, and a sybil cluster loses its stake once it is traced.
